name: Import coal for stalled production
description: Synthetic grain exports earn treasury funds so a trade post can import the coal input required by a second trade post's production recipe.
catalog:
openrepublic-economy 1
resource grain
trade grain buy 2 sell 3
resource coal
trade coal buy 4 sell 1
resource flour
utility power
building grain_export_post 1 1
  store grain 64
  recipe harvest every 1 out grain:2
  tradepost
end
building coal_import_mill 1 1
  store coal 64
  store flour 64
  recipe mill every 1 in coal:1 out flour:1
  tradepost
end
